description.value: Bean Around The World is a BC-based specialty coffee roaster with over 30 years in the industry, known for small-batch roasting and blends such as the long-running Rainforest Organic Dark. The brand operates multiple cafe locations alongside an active e-commerce business shipping beans across Canada and the US. Visiting cyclists can expect a no-smoking environment with both indoor and outdoor seating and vegetarian-friendly beverage options.
